settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Personal settings live with the account; company settings are in the Company section.

account.name: Name
account.demoNote: Demo: changing the email and deleting the account come with the server.
account.liveNote: Changing the email and deleting the account come in a later stage.

security.demoSession: Demo: there is no session; the list is shown as an example.
security.othersEnded: {count, plural, =0 {No other sessions were active.} one {# other session ended.} other {# other sessions ended.}}
security.passwordChanged: The password has been changed. Your other sessions have ended.
security.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. You can paste a password from a password manager.

preferences.pinNote: A hidden section moves to “More” and stays available.
preferences.assistantFocus: When the assistant window opens, jump to the latest message
preferences.demoNote: Demo: settings apply only in this browser window.
preferences.interestsHint: Topics, goals and regions can be changed in the questionnaire.

channels.untrustedNote: Emails and files from connections count as untrusted data and give the assistant no authority.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.body: Enter your password to continue. Sensitive changes need a recent sign-in.

secondFactor.title: Two-step verification
secondFactor.loadFailed: Could not load the two-step verification settings. Reload the page.
secondFactor.offHint: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app in addition to the password. Staff need it to open the administration console.
secondFactor.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# recovery code} other {# recovery codes}} of {total} left
secondFactor.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone if you do not have one yet.
secondFactor.step2: Add an account in the app with the key below, or on this device
secondFactor.step3: Enter the six-digit code the app shows.
secondFactor.setupExpired: The set-up took too long. Start again.
secondFactor.codesOnce: Store these recovery codes in a safe place now. They are shown only once, and each one works once if you lose your phone.
secondFactor.codesStored: I have stored the recovery codes
secondFactor.codeFormat: Enter the six digits shown in the app
secondFactor.recoveryFormat: A recovery code has 16 letters and digits
secondFactor.invalidCode: The code is not correct or was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.
secondFactor.resetPending: Support was asked to reset your two-step verification. Nothing changes until a second staff member approves it.
secondFactor.resetCooling: Support will reset your two-step verification on {date} unless you cancel it.

elevation.title: Confirm with the second factor
elevation.body: Staff actions need an elevated session. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
elevation.recoveryBody: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
elevation.enrolFirst: Set up two-step verification in the security settings first.
